# XoftCal
> Free home and construction calculators with formulas and worked examples: https://calculators.xoftsol.com/

## Calculators
- [Board Foot Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/board-foot-calculator.html): Find out exactly how many board feet of lumber you need — and what it should cost.
- [Sod Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/sod-calculator.html): How many rolls or pallets of sod does your yard need? Measure, enter, done.
- [Paver Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/paver-calculator.html): Pavers, gravel base and sand for your patio or walkway — calculated in seconds.
- [Fence Material Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/fence-material-calculator.html): Posts, rails, pickets and concrete for a wood fence — a complete material list.
- [Drywall Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/drywall-calculator.html): Sheets, screws, mud and tape for a room — no mid-project hardware store runs.
- [Asphalt Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/asphalt-calculator.html): How many tons of asphalt does your driveway or patch need? Get the tonnage right.
- [Retaining Wall Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/retaining-wall-calculator.html): Blocks, caps and gravel backfill for a segmental retaining wall, calculated properly.
- [Roof Pitch Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/roof-pitch-calculator.html): Rise over run, angle in degrees, slope percent and rafter length — all from two numbers.
- [Pool Salt Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/pool-salt-calculator.html): How many pounds — and bags — of salt your saltwater pool actually needs.
- [Pond Volume Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/pond-volume-calculator.html): Gallons in your pond — for the right pump, filter, liner and treatment doses.
- [Curtain Size Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/curtain-size-calculator.html): Panel width, fullness and length — curtains that look tailored, not skimpy.
- [Fabric Yardage Calculator](https://calculators.xoftsol.com/calculators/fabric-yardage-calculator.html): How many yards of fabric does your project need? No more guessing at the cutting counter.
